_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 70 (PaintSky) — a big CCR-curation session (9 PRs) that rebuilt the merge workspace. On the ✨ Suggested merges worklist and the per-row ⚇ Merge popup you can now: re-discipline a course right where you merge it (its Common SUBJ flips to the new canonical immediately, with a ⟲ 'letters catch up at the next fold' marker); filter candidates by level (Beg/Int/Adv/Lab/WkExp); slide one Conservative↔Aggressive bar to widen or tighten how many merges are suggested across every lane; and the checkboxes now start UN-checked (only the surviving ★ target is checked — you opt each course in). Behind the scenes, the grouping now understands word variants, so 'Conversational Japanese' and 'Japanese Conversation' (and ~866 more like them) finally group together — with an amber '⚠ Spans N disciplines' flag where a shared word might mean different things (music vs office 'keyboard'). The search-add bug is fixed too. NEXT (Fable): the big one — dock the worklist as a panel + merge the two popups into one shared editor.

items.text: When you ⚇ Merge a course, you can now also RE-DISCIPLINE the survivor (the discipline picker is no longer greyed out). Change it and its Common SUBJ previews the new canonical (e.g. → PHOT); the column shows PHOT ⟲ right away. The M-ID's letters physically re-key to PHOT at the next batched fold — the ⟲ marks that wait. Official C-ID/CCN courses stay locked.

✨ Suggested merges has new controls: Beg/Int/Adv/Lab/WkExp LEVEL filters (walk one band at a time; Lab stays separate from Lec), and one Conservative↔Aggressive SLIDER — drag right for more/looser suggestions, left for only tight ones (watch the 'of N' count move). The slider widens the QUEUE; it can't add courses to a group the grouping missed — use ➕ Add more for that.

Merge checkboxes now start UN-checked — only the surviving ★ target is pre-checked, and you tick each course you want folded in. (Deliberate, so a stray Confirm can't fold the wrong courses.) The ➕-added ones still arrive checked.

The worklist now groups WORD VARIANTS: 'Conversational Japanese' ↔ 'Japanese Conversation', 'Assisting' ↔ 'Assistant', 'Welding' ↔ 'Welds' (~866 more courses now group). Where a merge spans 2+ disciplines you'll see an amber '⚠ Spans N disciplines' note — usually fine (same course tagged differently), but eyeball it for homonyms (music vs office 'keyboard'). Confirm the language-conversation families when you get a chance — they're clean wins.
Standing bonus: we'll keep adding Arroyo-Seco-style California plein-air landscapes (Redmond, Guy Rose, Wendt, Payne) to First Light — flag any artist/work you'd love and we'll source it.

PRIORITY (scope-first): the merge-workspace EPIC. (1) Consolidate the two merge popups — the per-row ⚇ dialog and the ✨ worklist have drifted (re-discipline + search-fix only in the dialog; band filters/slider/★-target only in the worklist). Extract ONE shared merge-editor both embed (two feeders: ad-hoc seed vs precomputed group). (2) Dock the worklist as a collapsible panel in the CCR tab (Sam's pick) so the CCR list stays co-visible. Riskiest surface — write a scope doc first; both popups now have committed tests to guard the refactor.

When the merge wave settles (NOT per-merge): the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint — close gaps + re-sort 001,002… by title within each (canonical SUBJ4, band). Full Rule-7, unverified-only, ONE pass. Scope: docs/unverified_mid_renumber_scope.md. Dry-run first, Sam's go before apply + Supabase re-key.

TMC Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js (Sam: 'Go for A'): per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○) + structural checklist + a Ready/N-issues banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.

CPL-Assistant CCR/CER-grounded recommender ETL (green-lit, queued): build the CCR/CER/adoption-leverage ETL into shared Supabase so the Assistant can recommend the likely local course + credit rec. Scope: docs/kb-notes/cpl-assistant-ccr-cer-recommendation-scope.md.
